purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that restores a previously unscheduled self-owned Activity or Event Schedule by copying the exact prior activated placement payload into a new immutable MaterialStateRef and reopening currentness monotonically.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, restored_from_material_state_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, placement_payload jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Copies the exact prior activated placement payload into one new immutable schedule.placement MaterialState rather than reopening the retired current episode.
state_history.current_binding: Restoration is allowed only while the Schedule remains absent with no later placement-history episode; accepted Undo creates a fresh explicit current binding.
state_history.chronology: The new current-history episode starts strictly after the unschedule receipt timestamp.
state_history.immutability_policy: Undo never rewinds rows; stale basis or changed operation intent conflicts.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Migration-only capability removal; placement history must remain reconstructible.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime EXECUTE is granted while PUBLIC and dante_migrator EXECUTE are denied
typed self-scope admits only Activity or Event Schedule owners belonging to the authenticated self Person
Undo requires the exact unschedule receipt and true current absence
restored payload preserves the original temporal form and accepted precision
restoration creates a new MaterialState/current-history episode rather than DB rewind
same operation and same intent replay while stale or changed intent conflicts
Activity and Event share the same restoration/current-history mechanism
